resources.string: Project foundation. AI and travel data are not connected yet.
A thoughtful trip starts with a clear plan.
Step 1 of 3: destination and inclusive travel dates. Input forms will be implemented in the next UI step.
Step 2 of 3: travelers, total group budget, currency and an explicit transport-inclusion choice.
Step 3 of 3: purpose, preferences and review. Generation is unavailable until an authorized backend integration step.
No request is running. This destination reserves the future recovery/progress screen.
No generated itinerary. Future Save and Save changes will be explicit; this foundation never creates a saved version.
No budget estimates available. Unknown costs are not zero and are never presented as live quotes.
No saved trips yet. Drafts and unsaved results do not belong in this list.
No saved versions. History will be read-only; restore and compare are outside MVP.
Currency, world time and weather can be opened independently of a trip.
No rate provider connected. No illustrative value is shown as a real exchange rate.
World-time screen structure. Clock comparison will be implemented separately using device time and IANA zones.
No weather provider connected. No forecast is invented.
Language changes interface labels. It does not translate saved plans or change currency.
Saved plans will stay on this device. No cloud sync or backup.
Could not save language. Your previous selection is retained.
Could not read language settings. Retry to restore your selection.
Could not restore settings. Retry to continue.
Could not read saved trips. Retry when storage is available.
Choose your destination, travel dates and group budget.
No saved trips yet. After creating a plan, choose Save to keep it in My Trips.
Draft kept on this device. This is not a saved trip.
Changes could not be kept on this device. Retry before leaving.
Could not restore your draft. Retry to keep working safely.
Resume your draft, or discard it and start a new plan. Saved trips stay unchanged.
Choose a city and country from this build’s offline list. Live place search is not connected.
1–14 calendar days, including start and end dates.
1–8 travelers in total; at least one adult. Child age bands only, no birth dates.
Total for all travelers. Use . or , for decimals; no thousands separators.
Local time at destination. If omitted, the plan must disclose travel-day assumptions.
Up to 1,000 characters. Do not enter identity, payment or health records.
Your selected destination, dates, group details and notes will be sent to an AI service only when plan creation is connected and you explicitly generate. AI suggestions require your review.
Plan creation is not connected yet. You can prepare and keep your draft on this device. No request has been sent.
Choose a city and country from the suggestions.
Choose dates from today at destination, in order, for 1–14 inclusive days.
Enter whole numbers: at least 1 adult, 0–7 children, 1–8 people total.
Choose an age band for every child.
Enter a positive group budget without thousands separators.
Choose explicitly whether transport is included.
Choose an origin different from your destination.
Use HH:mm. For a one-day trip, departure cannot precede arrival.
No plan creation request is running
Create a plan when AI planning is available. An unfinished draft is never shown as a saved itinerary.
Unsaved result expires: %1$s. Kept for 24 hours from readiness.
Plan content: %1$s. Interface language does not translate this content.
No verified source observations. Check opening hours and availability before travel.
Resume your draft to prepare a new request. Saved versions stay unchanged.
Could not save this plan. Your previous saved version is unchanged.
Reopen the latest saved version. Keep this candidate until you resolve the conflict.
Save this result and discard newer draft edits?
This result uses the earlier brief shown in its summary. Cancel keeps both the result and newer draft edits.
Indicative estimate, not a live or bookable quote.
Committed versions, newest first. Historical versions can be read or shared; restore and compare are not available.
Trip deleted. Undo is available for five seconds.
Local cleanup failed. Retry; deleted content must not reappear.
Compare currencies with a dated reference rate when a provider is available.
No exchange rate available. Change the pair or retry when the rate service is connected.
Cached reference rate is out of date. Do not treat it as a live quote.
This currency pair is unavailable. Choose another pair.
Same currency — no exchange is needed. %1$s %2$s
Device clock and IANA time zones. No network or location permission required.
Offset from your zone at this instant: %1$s
Based on the device clock; check device time settings if inaccurate.
Weather is not available yet. No forecast is inferred. Choose a city and retry when the service is connected.
Choose a city instead. Location lookup is not connected in this build.
Forecast not available for these dates.
Cached weather is out of date. Check its source time before use.
Location permission was denied. Choose a city manually.
Location permission is blocked. Choose a city or manage permission in Android Settings.
Loading weather for the selected city…
Could not load weather. Keep the selected city and retry.
Display preferences do not convert existing budgets or change existing draft currencies.

Your draft and saved destinations stay on this device. If you generate a plan, your trip details are sent for AI processing. When you open a booking website, that website’s terms and privacy policy apply. Search details are shared only when the app can prefill the website.

A draft is kept until you discard it or remove local data. Future unsaved results expire 24 hours after readiness. Explicitly saved versions do not expire. Device loss or uninstall can remove local content permanently.

Keep a draft to continue editing. Save adds a completed result to My Trips; autosave does not. History is read-only. AI planning, currency rates and weather will require service integration. World time works offline.

Planning suggestions and cost estimates require verification. This is a development UI build without booking or live provider data. Production legal terms and the final privacy policy must be completed before release.
Remove trips, history, saved destinations and unfinished work from this device. This cannot be undone. Language and display preferences are kept.
Could not remove local data. Retry; existing content is retained.
UI SAMPLE · Illustrative content only. No generation, provider lookup or Save is performed.
Preview only. No trip or version was saved.
This is an illustrative UI state. Real actions require validated data and the later persistence/service integration.
Checking whether your request started. Check the same request; do not generate again.
Recovering the existing request. No new request is submitted.
Could not create your plan. Your saved plan is unchanged.
Could not create a usable plan. No invalid result will be displayed.
Plan creation is unavailable right now. Retry only when permitted.
Request canceled. Your draft is available.
Late result ignored. Canceled or failed requests cannot activate a result.
You are offline. Your draft is kept on this device. No request is queued.
Preview rename: the real saved trip is unchanged.
Could not save display preferences. Your previous selection is retained.
No observed conditions or forecast available.
This draft is no longer available. Return Home to start a new plan.
Enter a positive amount without thousands separators.
Could not restore display preferences. Retry.
Travel time and opening hours are not verified
Activity overlaps and arrival/departure limits are checked. Transfer routes and opening hours need a verified provider; unknown costs are not zero.
Generate through the local backend. Saved trips stay on this device.
Cannot reach the local service or save this request. Your draft is kept. Check the USB connection and try again.
The AI service temporarily limited generation. Your draft and previous itinerary are kept. No automatic retry. Return to review to try again later, or explicitly choose mock data for testing.
This request belongs to a different or expired local session. Keep your draft, cancel this request, then generate again. Saved trips are unaffected.
Canceled on this device. If offline, cancellation will sync before the next request. Late results will not replace your itinerary.
The response is uncertain. Check status to recover the same request. Your current itinerary is kept; do not start another request.
Preparing your itinerary. You can return Home and resume this request later. Check status reuses the same request.
Ready to review. Check activities, timing and budget before Save. This result is not saved yet.
No replacement itinerary was accepted. Your draft, current itinerary and saved versions are kept. Edit the brief to try again.
Sample data only. Not AI output or real travel advice. Routes, hours and all costs are unverified. This label remains after Save and offline reopening.

Canceled locally; remote cancellation could not be confirmed because the session is unavailable. Late results will be ignored. A new session will be created only when you explicitly Generate again. The previous AI request may already have used quota.
No browser is available. The saved itinerary remains on this device.
AI generation is unavailable because its service quota is exhausted. Your draft and saved versions are kept. Try again when quota is available, or explicitly choose mock data for testing.
The local service has reached its daily generation limit. Your draft and saved versions are kept. Try again after the limit resets, or explicitly choose mock data for testing.
Too many local sessions were requested. No itinerary request was submitted. Your draft is kept. Wait before trying again.
The previous action is still finishing. Wait a moment before starting another request. Your draft is kept.
The AI service is temporarily unavailable (503). Bounded retries have stopped. Your draft and saved versions are kept. Try again later, or explicitly use labeled mock data for testing.

Spend time by the sea and make room for a visit to the Marble Mountains.
Look near My Khe when beach access matters. Consider the Han River area if you want to spend more time in the city.
Explore the Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake, with time to try local food.
Start with the Old Quarter for walks around Hoan Kiem Lake. Consider the West Lake area for a different pace.
Build a city break around markets, museums and cafes in central Ho Chi Minh City.
Look around District 1 if your plans include Ben Thanh Market and central museums. Check the location against the places you want to visit.
